title: Raptor (Russian Player)
wikitext:
Graduated from MIREA (together with AlexRed).

I love my wife, computers and friends, Doom, Quake 2, Heroes of Might and Magic II, Microprose Magic: The Gathering, Blind Guardian, chess, preference and much more. I adore Railgun with all that it implies... I don't like playing FPS on the Internet, as it's unfair (I prefer LAN).

I love beer so much that I can't drink it anymore because I'm oversaturated with this product!.. :)

I have a cheerful, sociable character.

In the game, I strictly follow my grandfather's advice: Height - Speed ​​- Maneuver - Fire!
